We called into Pets At Home Crown Point Leeds branch today to pick up a click and collect order.

When we arrived Young man at the checkout greeted us in a friendly way and showed interest in our 11 month old Staffy cross Ben.

We asked about flea treatment for Ben and James not only offered to weigh our pup to help make sure we got the correct product. He also gave us some good advice about supplements for him.

The greeting, tidiness of the store and the attitude of all of the staff who interacted with us was outstanding but James deserves a special mention as he did a great job and is a credit to Pets At Home

Thanks James.

Stephen, John and Ben

If you're looking for a well stocked pet shop, this is the place to go! The store is spacious and has everything you need for any type of pet whether you have a cat, dog, bird, fish, reptile, or even small rodents. They offer a wide range of pet food, accessories, toys, and even medicines to keep your animals healthy. One of the best things about this shop is that they also sell live food for reptiles and other pets, as well as live animals for those looking to bring home a new companion. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always ready to help with advice or recommendations

Overall, it's a fantastic pet store with a huge selection and great service. Highly recommended for any pet owner!

A big shout out for them team. I cannot possibly thank tammy and the team enough for been so helpful with our fish tank over these passed few months, we have lost so many fish from the start. We have taken water samples here and bought fish also, everything was off the charts they helped in so many ways and recommended stuff to use in our tank to help with this situation and also water changes to help bring the nitrites down and ammonia. We did this every day then left it a day and took another water sample to see where we was at to finally get to point of not losing any fish the water is now spot on and the fish are happy too we also have babies in our tank which are also happy and healthy swimming about. Thank you so so much to the team. I would 100% recommend anyone having any issues or not sure about anything to go see the team here there always happy to help
